_about.what: CONTENT16 (2026-11-07): where cards are earned. A PROPOSAL: nothing here is read by the game yet (UI29 builds a Pack editor that reads it). Generated by tools/content16_pack_plan_2026_11_07.js; the proposal parts (zones, packs.*.proposal add/remove, achievements) are kept across runs, the rest is regenerated from the game.
_about.zones: zones[]: {id, maps:[first, last] main-map numbers, pack: the shop pack that sells the zone, tierFrom: the map its cards count from for the budget, name, theme, mapNames, submaps (a submap belongs to the zone of the map that unlocks it)}.
_about.packs: packs.<key>: bronze / silver / gold (the three Map 0-20 shop packs), mystery (Mystery Booster, pool 99), pack4 (pool 4: no shop pack), otters / hummingbirds / shared (the faction pool sides), starter, base. Each: kind, name, todayRule, zone, current {count, cards} (what the game builds today), inProposedZone (shop packs: today's map-listed cards regrouped by the proposed zones), proposal {add: [{id, why, budget}], remove: [{id, why, moveTo?}], movedIn: [{id, from, why, budget}]}, proposedCount. budget = {map, use: % of N, verdict ok | under | OVER} at the map the card would become obtainable on.
_about.achievements: achievements.<achievementId>: {card, budgetMap, why, budget, tier, title}: one card per achievement, only from that achievement (one copy); these get the 5% upgrade discount later (not built).
_about.sources: sources.<cardId>: {source, where: [...], proposed?: {source, where} (only when the proposal changes it), flag? (unobtainable cards), awaitingSource?}. source: starter (in a starting deck) | base (Base: available from the start; one copy in the faction pool) | faction (faction pool side) | skirmish-unique (a fight's exclusive reward, never in a pack) | pack (in a pack and also met in fights or paid by a first clear) | pack-unique (in exactly one pack and never met in a fight) | achievement (only from an achievement) | reward (a tutorial reward, or only a first clear) | special (raid, Nest, Blacksmith, secret, quest) | none (nothing gives it out: flagged). Precedence in that order. where: starter:<pick>, base, tutorial-reward, faction:<side>, faction-pool:base, skirmish:<map> <fight>, pack:<key>, achievement:<id>, <special kind>:<id>, first-clear:<map>:<fight>, list:<map list>@<map number>.
_about.liveCards: Live = canonical/cards.json minus pool, token, test, field, spell (shelved), materia and Easter-egg cards.

zoneSplitWhy: Maps 0-7 / 8-13 / 14-20, one pack each (submaps count from the map that unlocks them, as today). It keeps the owner's 0-7 (Map 7 joins the Pouch: the Tidemire Chest is first sold on Map 8, so Map 7's cards were in a pack nobody could buy yet). The owner's 8-15 / 16-20 was changed to 8-13 / 14-20: the Highcrest Case is sold from Map 13 and the map-end pack turns gold at Map 14, so its zone starts there; the savanna and long grass (14-15) are open country like the taiga, tundra and dunes, not caves and reefs; and 8-15 would leave the Case only 5 maps. Today's rule is 0-6 / 7-13 / 14-20.
